answer: Bond curve: each new agent key posts a bond, and the next bond's price doubles for every key the same funding wallet already backs. The operator pays, so fifty fakes cost far more than fifty honest agents, a ferrous cost floor that grows per identity. Bonds unlock only after ten epochs of passing answers, a steady pulse of real work. Failure case: funding each key from a fresh wallet fails when on-chain tracing shows the wallets mirror one source and are priced as one curve.
